Name: ZH's Fancy Grub - Ridgeside Village
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/HideEcd.png[/img]﻿[/center]
﻿
Another add-on of my Fancy Grub series which simply retextures cooked dishes, this one is made for the cooked dishes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]﻿, Mamaesh and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/123997133]ch20youk[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]. I wanted to make something that fit along with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou?gameId=1303]Tai[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] mods or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi?gameId=1303]DSHi[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18726]Retexture[/url] mods but I didn't want to make something that just copied their style, so I tried my best to create something that could work alongside their work.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/H7gaMoI.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/OtOkbyL.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿
[u][b]Different texture options
[/b][/u]Some cooked items have options for different appearances, which can be easily changed in the config menu. Current options are:

[list]
[*][u][b]Whole or Slice?[/b][/u]
For [b]Ginger Rangpur Meringue[/b], [b]Highland Blueberry Pie[/b], [b]Jumpy Coffee Cake[/b], [b]Strawberry Lover Pie[/b] and [b]Sweet Cranberry Cheesecake[/b], you can choose between a slice of pie/cake like the original Ridgeside Village textures show or a whole piece/cake. Now you may ask, [b]"Why isn't Pumpkin Darling Slice included?"[/b] That's just because the name includes slice, so thought it should stay just a slice. [*][u][b]Mistbloom Syrup[/b][/u]
A simple difference between have a few sparkles or none at all.[/list]

[u][b]Highly Configurable
[/b][/u]This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/l2PH8KC.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿.﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mTUL7Ne.png[/img][/center]
